h1: The 6 Best DeWalt Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best DeWalt Leaf Blowers 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: two DeWalt blowers and four third-party blowers built for DeWalt 20V batteries, compared on stated CFM, power and price bracket.
summary: Only two blowers here are actually made by DeWalt: the 20V MAX Blower and the 60V DCBL772B. The rest are third-party tools that use DeWalt 20V batteries. The DCBL772B is the strongest official pick, and the 700 CFM ALDIPRO is the value option if you already own the batteries.
intro: The easy mistake is assuming every DeWalt-compatible blower is a DeWalt product. Four of the six here are made by other brands and merely accept DeWalt 20V batteries, which means different warranties and no official support.

We reviewed two true DeWalt models and four battery-compatible alternatives, ranking them on stated airflow in CFM, cordless power and price bracket. Milwaukee-battery blowers were left out because they do not fit DeWalt packs.

products.name: Dewalt Blower AXIAL HNDHLD 60V 600CFM DCBL772B
products.description:
The DCBL772B is a handheld axial blower rated at 600 CFM on the 60V platform. It is a genuine DeWalt product in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks first because it combines the brand's own build with the highest official airflow. The DeWalt 20V MAX Blower is cheaper in spec but only 100 CFM.

Buy it if you use 60V batteries. Skip it if you only own 20V packs.

products.name: ALDIPRO 700 CFM Leaf Blower Compatible with DeWalt 20V Max Battery
products.verdict: The highest stated CFM here, built for DeWalt 20V packs.
products.description:
The ALDIPRO is a cordless blower rated at 700 CFM and built to take DeWalt 20V Max batteries. It is a third-party tool in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks second because it beats every blower here on stated airflow at a lower bracket, but it is not a DeWalt product.

Buy it if you own 20V batteries. Skip it if you want official DeWalt support.

products.name: Paxwrenx 600 CFM Brushless Leaf Blower Compatible with DeWalt 20V Max
products.verdict: A brushless 600 CFM blower for DeWalt 20V.
products.description:
The Paxwrenx is a cordless brushless blower rated at 600 CFM and compatible with DeWalt 20V Max batteries, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks third because 100 CFM less than the ALDIPRO is a small gap, and the brushless motor is the selling point.

Buy it for a brushless design. Skip it if you want the most airflow.

products.name: Neareen 600 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower for Dewalt 20V Max Battery
products.verdict: A 600 CFM cordless blower for DeWalt 20V batteries.
products.description:
The Neareen is a cordless blower rated at 600 CFM, built for DeWalt 20V Max batteries, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks fourth because the Paxwrenx matches its airflow and adds a brushless motor.

Buy it for light yard work. Skip it if a brushless motor matters.

products.name: AUTOJARE Cordless Leaf Blower for Dewalt 20V Battery Brushless Electric Blower
products.verdict: A 520 CFM brushless blower for DeWalt 20V.
products.description:
The AUTOJARE is a cordless brushless blower rated at 520 CFM for DeWalt 20V batteries. The listing does not give a price bracket, so check the live price.

It ranks fifth because its airflow is the lowest of the compatible blowers.

Buy it if the price is right. Skip it if you need more airflow.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Blower
products.verdict: The genuine DeWalt 20V option, at 100 CFM.
products.description:
The DEWALT 20V MAX Blower is a cordless unit rated at 100 CFM, in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks last because 100 CFM trails every other blower here by hundreds of CFM, though it is the only genuine 20V DeWalt.

Buy it for patios and light cleanup. Skip it for leaf piles.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is cubic feet of air per minute and measures airflow volume. A higher number moves more leaves. Look for it in the title or specs.
20V and 60V DeWalt packs are not interchangeable. Check which one the blower takes before buying.
A compatible blower is not made by DeWalt. That affects warranty and support. Check the maker named on the listing.
Brushless motors tend to be more efficient. Look for the word brushless on the listing.
Many are sold as bare tools. Check whether battery and charger are included.

finalTake: The DeWalt DCBL772B is the pick for 60V owners who want a genuine tool, while the ALDIPRO 700 CFM offers more air for 20V owners at a lower bracket. Only two of these are made by DeWalt, so read the maker before you buy.
